newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug copper exports, imports detailed.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug copper exports, imports detailed.

text.p: China's exports of uncast and raw copper dropped 12.7 percent year-on-year to 69,189 tonnes in the first eight months of 1996, customs figures showed on Monday.
Exports reached 9,213 tonnes in August alone.
Exports of uncast copper including alloys slumped 8.9 percent to 25,616 tonnes in the first eight months.
Raw copper exports fell 14.7 percent to 43,573 tonnes, down from 51,132 tonnes in the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Imports of uncast and raw copper rose 24.0 percent year-on-year to 401,080 tonnes in the first eight months.
Imports of uncast and raw copper reached 57,770 tonnes in August alone.

Imports of uncast copper including alloys were up 47.2 percent year-on-year to 148,594 tonnes in the first eight months. Imports of raw copper were 252,486 tonnes, up 13.5 percent from the year-ago period.
